device_entry.name: CRSF遥控器桥接接口
tags: 移动机器人与自动驾驶实验
足式机器人控制与感知实验
device_entry.description: 这是一类基于 CRSF 控制链路的手持遥控器/接收接口，用于把摇杆与开关输入传给机器人系统。在实验室中，它常用于对移动机器人或四足机器人进行人工遥操作、模式切换和基础运动控制。
device_entry.description_en: This is a CRSF-based handheld remote controller and receiver interface used to pass stick and switch inputs into a robotic system. In laboratory use, it is commonly used for manual teleoperation, mode switching, and basic motion control of mobile robots or quadrupeds.

schema.description: 启动与 CRSF 遥控接收链路的串口通信。
schema.description_en: Start serial communication with the CRSF remote control link.

schema.description: 读取来自 CRSF 遥控器的串口控制数据包。
schema.description_en: Read serial control packets coming from the CRSF remote controller.

schema.description: 解析 CRSF 控制数据包并转换为摇杆与按键状态。
schema.description_en: Decode a CRSF control packet and convert it into joystick axes and button states.

schema.description: 输出当前遥控器的摇杆与开关状态。
schema.description_en: Publish the current stick and switch state of the remote controller.

schema.description: 关闭遥控器通信并清理连接资源。
schema.description_en: Shut down the controller communication and clean up connection resources.
